text:
emily: quick ping 1 - we keep hitting messy client caches when pins are returned as the only identifier. proposal: emit an optional `claim` object that's separated from pins/aliases so we have a stable, typed model identity to reason about
noah: +1 on separation. caller SDKs should still be allowed to use pins for compatibility but server logic relies on claim.id for deterministic routing
rachel: what fields are we thinking in `claim`? needs to be small and non-opinionated
diego: minimal sketch I like:
```
"claim": {
  "type": "canonical",    // canonical | alias | source
  "id": "sha256:abcd...", // long-lived content hash
  "name": "redwood/gptx-small@v2", // human label, optional
  "issuer": "catalog",     // minting service
  "cacheable": false        // hint: clients SHOULD NOT cache unless true
}
```
emily: agree with `cacheable` boolean hint. default false to avoid accidental caching. also allow `cache_ttl_seconds` when cacheable=true
noah: lifecycle controls (expiry, revocation) should stay in rollout metadata, not in claim. claim==identity, policy==metadata
rachel: operational flow: when older rollouts only contain `pin`, shim creates claim with type=alias and issuer=shim-service, attaches provenance pointing at original pin in audit logs
diego: keep the shim server-side and add an opt-in header so old clients don't break: `X-Model-Claim-V1: true` when we include claim in body. new SDKs can read body, old SDKs ignore header
emily: I prefer header opt-in because it lets us A/B the rollout and avoid forcing SDK bumps immediately. ops: any blockers?
deploy-bot: schema-change-check: adding optional `claim` to responses requires SDK + console updates. If not quarantined behind header, this will be treated as a minor breaking change for some integrations
noah: mitigation: mark `claim` optional, default omit for legacy rollouts; also set `claim.cacheable=false` in shim-produced claims so naive clients won't store it even if they see it
rachel: telemetry note: include a hashed form of claim.id in traces and logs, and when exporting to external sinks, replace id with sha256(id+salt) to avoid leakage
diego: agree. and include `claim.issuer` in audit trails to help backtraces without leaking model internals to customers
emily: SDK contract: add `ModelClaim` type, but keep parsing tolerant: if claim absent, fallback to pin/alias as today. we'll add a migration guide for SDK consumers
noah: testing: need unit tests for shim conversions (pin -> claim alias), integration tests for header gating, and e2e verifying cache TTL respected by SDKs
rachel: ops task: console should only render claim to users when explicit flag enabled in product; otherwise surface the old pin label to avoid confusing UI teams
deploy-bot: flagged: schedule a 30m sync with SDK, console, infra, and security for vetting. block minor release until shim edgecase tests are green
emily: action items:
- diego: spike shim and header emission (next week)
- noah: draft SDK parse + migration docs (after spike)
- rachel: update telemetry scrub rules and console rendering notes
I'll file the RFC follow-up with the example manifests and test checklist
deploy-bot: sync scheduled: Fri 11am PT. RFC link will be attached to calendar invite when filed
emily: thanks all 3 :thumbsup: end thread
